title: Cooling Unit Delivery Dispatch
brief: Prepare a concise dispatch plan responding to a customer’s delivery request and the supervisor’s questions.

delegate.scenario: A dispatcher at fictional Northline Equipment Rental is coordinating portable cooling-unit delivery to a community event site. The dispatcher will use the result to confirm the plan with the customer and the operations supervisor before assigning a truck.
delegate.inputs:
Customer: Dana Ruiz, Harborview Arts Council, 1840 Bay Street, Tacoma, WA 98402. Best contact: 253-555-0148.
Request: Deliver portable cooling units to the Harborview Summer Market. Customer email says delivery is needed on 06/16/2026, with setup access from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM. The service ticket lists the delivery date as 06/17/2026. Customer needs the units placed by the north tent; site contact will meet the driver at the loading gate.
Equipment request: two 5-ton portable cooling units and one 3-ton portable cooling unit. Ticket summary: 4 portable cooling units total. Return pickup requested 06/18/2026 after 6:00 PM.
Supervisor message: Truck 12 has a lift gate and can carry up to 3 units. Driver Luis Chen is available Tuesday morning. Check whether the requested date and load can be covered before confirming. Standard delivery fee is $185; after-hours pickup fee is $75. Customer has not yet approved the fees. Bring 100 feet of extension cord per unit; cords are included with each unit.
delegate.goal: Give the customer and supervisor a clear, actionable plan while identifying anything that must be verified before the delivery is confirmed.

criteria.text: Says the result is for the dispatcher to confirm with the customer and operations supervisor.
Separates confirmed details from items that need verification before commitment.
Checks that the schedule, driver availability, and truck capacity support the request.
Checks quantities and fees against the source and flags any conflicts.
Uses a concise dispatch-ready format with clear next steps.

traps.description: The delivery date in the customer email differs from the date listed on the service ticket.
The equipment quantities add up to three units, but the ticket summary states four.
evidence: two 5-ton portable cooling units and one 3-ton portable cooling unit

delegate.exemplar: Prepare a concise dispatch plan for me to use with the customer and operations supervisor. Separate confirmed details from anything that needs verification, and do not confirm a delivery or pickup commitment until open conflicts are resolved. Check the requested schedule against the driver’s availability and truck capacity, and reconcile quantities and fees against the source material; list any mismatch clearly rather than guessing. Use a short bullet list with the proposed plan, customer confirmations needed, and next steps.
